BrochureContent.Content:
8 the orchards is a  three-bedroom semi-detached home situated in the mature and highly sought-after residential enclave of The Orchards, just off Glasheen Road. The property benefits from a superb location, offering a peaceful setting while remaining within easy reach of Cork city centre, University College Cork, Cork University Hospital, Bon Secours Hospital, excellent schools, shops and a range of local amenities. The area is also well served by public transport and enjoys convenient access to the South Ring Road, making it an ideal location for families and  alike.

The property has been renovated and upgraded in recent years, creating a bright, modern home that is ready for immediate occupation. Well-presented throughout, it offers comfortable accommodation with quality finishes while retaining the charm of its established setting.
